buildings.name: Capital
buildings.comment: Your seat of power. Your Capital Lv determines the construction and upgrade limits of most buildings.

buildings.name: He3 Mine
buildings.comment: Refined He3 is fuel that drives construction and sustains ship production. It also powers war ships during long expeditions and life-and-death battles in deep space.

buildings.name: Metal Extractor
buildings.comment: Metal is the foundation of every properous colony.

buildings.name: Housing District
buildings.comment: Housing Districts generate Gold through taxes. The higher the District level, the more Gold they can produce.

buildings.name: Storage Silo
buildings.comment: Stores a limited amount of He3, Metal, and Gold.

buildings.name: Academy
buildings.comment: This is where the Federation's finest Captains live and train. Captains become available for hire upon construction.

buildings.name: Guild Office
buildings.comment: Grants access to Guild-related features.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.comment: Allows war ships to be manufactured on this colony. The Ship Factory's level determines the rate that ships can be manufactured.

buildings.name: Science Institute
buildings.comment: Science and technology are key to a productive and prosperous colony. This institute will help you to stay on top of cutting-edge science.

buildings.name: Research Facility
buildings.comment: Military technology is researched and developed in this facility. Upgrade this building to unlock new ships and updates to existing ship blueprints.

buildings.name: Trade Center
buildings.comment: The commercial center of every colony where goods and resources can be traded.

buildings.name: Space Station
buildings.comment: The hub of a colony. With every upgrade, new buildings are unlocked and certain building limits are raised.

buildings.name: Radar
buildings.comment: Detects resource-rich players within your vicinity as your next raid target.

buildings.name: Barricade
buildings.comment: Basic defensive structures. Creates an impassable obstacle against enemy ships until it's destroyed.

buildings.name: Particle Cannon
buildings.comment: Weapon that attacks a single fleet every Round.

buildings.name: Hydra Cannon
buildings.comment: Weapon that deals damage to a target its surrounding fleets every Round.

buildings.name: Thor's Cannon
buildings.comment: Weapon that deals damage to every fleet within a certain area every Round.

buildings.name: Monument
buildings.comment: Increases Metal Production

buildings.name: Fountain
buildings.comment: Increases He3 Production

buildings.name: Park
buildings.comment: Increases Gold Production

buildings.name: Statue
buildings.comment: Increases research speed

buildings.name: Hangar
buildings.comment: Repairs destroyed ships and scraps ships for resources.

commanders.Name: Angla
commanders.Comment: Reduces hospital time and prevents anyone from killing the Commander. Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Angla is the most mysterious commander of them all. Rumor has it her DNA was modified and strengthened when she was young, and many believe it. Those who have served with her speak of a fearlessness bordering on recklessness. Whether or not the rumors are true, this much is certain: she is one of the most experienced commanders available, and the veteran of too many campaigns to count, but she has never spent more than a few days in a hospital, no matter how badly she was injured.

commanders.Name: Rio
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to reduce the maximum Structure and Shield values of enemy fleets within 2 spaces by 5% after every turn. Affected by the Focus attribute.
commanders.Description: Nobody knows where he comes from or how his fleets move like ghosts elluding detection. Sandora, the only captain who has ever seen him in battle, has this to say about him: 'When I got close to him, I felt as though his fleet was constantly phasing from spot to spot. All our defenses gradually withered away. I will never forget that moment.'

commanders.Name: Natiya Veda
commanders.Comment: At the start of each round, has a chance to increase the Captain's Initiative by its level x10. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: A skilled soldier of the Federation, Natiya graduated as the top student at Orion Point Academy. She volunteered for an experimental soldier-enhancement program that modified her parietal lobe, granting her a superhuman spatial awareness. Natiya's ability to plan and maneuver fleets and the Initiative with which she responds to changing enemy formations is unmatched.

commanders.Name: Reginald
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to reduce the enemy Captain's attack power and seal the use of his or her skill for the next round. Affected by the Focus attribute.
commanders.Description: Reginald, or 'Rad Reggie' as some would call him was a brilliant cybernetics engineer and biologist. As his experiments became more cutting edge, his desire to break new ground intensified. He felt the clinical trial protocols and ethical restrictions were holding back his progress and decided that his own body was the only legal playground for his ideas. He became a living weapon and now he operates as a black ops agent for the Federation.

commanders.Name: Evey Snabar
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to ignore enemy defensive modules while attacking. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Evey Snabar has served the Federation military for over a decade and is the epitome of determination and graft. A soldier for four years and an officer for another five, Evey has taken fleet captain aptitude tests every year with the Academy. At the grand old age of 35, Evey was finally commissioned as a fleet captain. Meticulous to a fault, Evey's ability to plan for battle is absolutely thorough. She can effectively counter any defensive measures.

commanders.Name: Stani Baradeon
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to prevent the enemy from moving and attacking for the next round. Affected by the Accuracy and Focus attributes.
commanders.Description: Stani Baradeon was once a very promising junior officer. He was highly respected among his peers and earned his own command before his 25th birthday. But a bad mistake on an away mission left him gravely injured, seemingly ending his career. A determined Stani worked with Federation scientists on an experimental project, and together they remade him into Cyborg Stani. Since then, he developed technopathy and now spends his time talking to machines instead of humans.

commanders.Name: Sephina
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to move an extra 3 squares. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: Sephina joined the ranks of the Federation as a mechanic and ballistics expert. While Sephina isn't trained in combat like most other Federation Captains, she's proven herself to be a master of fleet maneuvering. Since taking down a Corsair flagship eight Earth-years ago with no more than a squadron of frigates and some impressive guerrilla tactics, Sephina has become a renowned fleet captain within the Federation.

commanders.Name: Jace
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to prevent modules from consuming He3 while attacking or defending. Affected by the Focus attribute.
commanders.Description: When Earth Colony 346 experienced an energy crisis due to a massive coordinated blockade by the Vong, the Federation turned to the Maun for help. The Maun made great strides in the development of fusion power and efficient energy usage. Chief among their engineers is Jace who joined the Federation as a Captain when he saw the opportunity to wreak vengeance upon the Vong.

commanders.Name: Maletiz
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to absorb all damage and reflect it back to the attacker. Affected by the Evasion and Focus attributes.
commanders.Description: Maletiz is the last of a mysterious race that had all but been wiped out by the Xanthas. Captured and forced to fight in Xant's vanguard, Maletiz was apprehended by Federation forces in the battle of Wolf 298. He immediately offered his services to the Federation and played a key role in the war. Not much is known of Maletiz's past, but his pain and desire for vengeance make him fight with a rage that threatens to overwhelm his enemies.

commanders.Name: Niet-Khuul
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to reduce damage from attacks to 0. Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Niet-Khuul is a Xen, exiled for heresy and occultism. Said to possess extraordinary powers, Niet-Khuul has put them to good use as a fleet captain within the Federation. His motivations to help the Federation are as mysterious as his tricks, leaving his allies and foes alike in awe and fear. Niet-Khuul's abilities are no parlor tricks, for many of the Federation's finest captains have sought him out to study under him. Chief among his disciples is Dilira.

commanders.Name: Jero
commanders.Comment: When attacked, has a chance to inflict a condition on the enemy fleet, causing it to take 10% more damage in the next round (stackable). Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Jero was granted a controversial amnesty by the Federation after the rise of the Corsairs. He became a fugitive after he was found guilty for developing and dealing deadly bio-chemical weapons. However, Jero's expertise in such technology was deemed necessary in fighting the Corsairs. Trusting Jero was the lesser of two evils. He now commands a bio-organically enhanced crew. They use unconventional weapons that weaken anyone foolish enough to engage Jero's fleet in a dogfight.

commanders.Name: Jaa-si Leen
commanders.Comment: Has a chance when attacking to reduce the enemy Captain's 4 attributes to 0 for the next Round. Affected by Initiative and Focus attributes.
commanders.Description: Hailing from the distant planet of Xen Yooberis, Jaa-si Leen was abducted by pirates when she was just an infant. To survive, she learned to cheat, lie, fight, and kill, stretching out a tenuous life among the pirates. When her ship was apprehended by a Federation fleet, Jaa-si exacted her revenge, betraying her crew and surrendering to the enemy captain. Despite being regarded as an outlaw and a maverick, she rose rapidly among the ranks of the Federation due to her skills.

commanders.Name: Alicia Pike
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to increase damage dealt by the ship in the next slot of the formation by 30%. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: If there ever was a popularity contest within the Federation military, Alicia Pike would win hands down. The Pike name is a proud legacy, one with a long line of decorated commanders. Alicia has repeatedly proven herself worthy of her surname. An experienced Captain, Alicia's humble ways have endeared her among the rank and file. She's an inspiration to many Federation Academy cadets.

commanders.Name: Bonicca
commanders.Comment: Increases the chance of interception. Affected by the Focus attribute.
commanders.Description: The military aggression of the Corsairs isn't the only menace of the Galactic Federation. For decades, there's been internal turmoil. Federation leaders bicker over how to deal with this threat. Bonicca is on the extreme end of the spectrum. She believes that these outlaws must be actively persecuted under the full might of the Federation military. Her take-no-prisoners zeal is a source of controversy, but her expertise in neutralizing heavy weaponry is a huge asset.

commanders.Name: B9
commanders.Comment: Increases allied Shields and Hull within 4 squares by 8% after each round. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: B9 is the third of six known androids designed by the legendary Dr. Yuteng Hoong. Planned as a simple experiment on artificial intelligence, B9 advanced more quickly than Dr. Hoong had originally hoped. After going through many rigorous tests and examinations, B9 became the first android to ever captain a Federation fleet. With his special skills in engineering and support, B9 is always a welcome sight on the battlefield.

commanders.Name: Kerrin
commanders.Comment: During movement, has a chance to recover 15% of fleet's Hull. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: A polymath. A multi-hyphenate. Call Kerrin what you will, because she is the master of all trades. She's done it all, first as an engineer, then a politician, then an administrator on a core planet, then a diplomat to keep the peace in a fracturing Federation. She finally decided to fight as a peacekeeper and a fleet captain for the Federation, believing there will never be long-lasting peace so long as the Corsairs remain. Kerrin teaches in her downtime, as her way to unwind.

commanders.Name: Rayph
commanders.Comment: During movement, has a chance to increase Integrated Defense by 5 for 1 Round. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: The always debonair Rayph is often referred to as the 'Face of the Federation.' He's often featured in the Federation's recruitment campaigns. But don't let his pretty-boy looks fool you. Rayph is a stern captain and firm believer in regimentation and discipline. Rayph is also an expert on neutralizing enemy fire and defensive reinforcements, an interest shared by his one-time classmate Shabasti, whom he works in close tandem with.

commanders.Name: Donna Yomin
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to restore 15% of maximum Shields at the start of each round. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: Donna Yomin was drafted into the Federation Militia at a very young age. Her innate talent as a soldier, pilot, and leader was evident even then. But Donna possesses an empathetic streak that makes her conflicted about her military career. Once a commander of a fringe colony, she was ordered to abandon her base and protect the inner planets from a massive coordinated assault by the Space Corsairs. Donna left the Federation to dedicate herself to defending other fringe colonies from Corsairs.

commanders.Name: Zylvar
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to deal 150% additional damage to Buildings.
commanders.Description: Zylvar did not have the privilege of an elite military pedigree as most captains do. He joined the Federation military as a field engineer, and was an acclaimed civil engineer and demolitionist before that. Since then, Zylvar has since become the go-to expert for siege weaponry and planetary assault tactics.

commanders.Name: Gerista
commanders.Comment: Increases Critical Strike rate. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Behind Gerista's mask is cold smile and a terrifying killing streak. Her fleet has always displayed a stunning ability to swiftly surround the enemy right at the start of battle to deliver a crippling blow.

commanders.Name: Draxido
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to deal Lucky Shot, which increases the chance of shooting down a target by 50%. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: The son of the ex-President of the Federation, Draxido was on the fast track for success. That is, until his father was found guilty of corruption. Draxido was instantly blacklisted, serving as a turret washer for three years before he unintentionally saved the Maulv ambassador from a space slug. He was promoted to Admiral, only to be instantly demoted when he arrived late to his own ceremony. Though he is an able captain, one thing is for sure: When Draxido is around, you never know what might happen.

commanders.Name: Wainwright
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to deal double damage to the enemy. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Wainwright was born to fight. Growing up in a rough neighborhood made him into a formidable brawler. But he didn't stop at unarmed combat. He became a master-of-arms as he rose through the ranks of the Federation militia. Wainwright was able to translate his close-combat prowess into a knack for piloting spacecrafts and commanding fleets. Along the way, he's built a fearsome reputation as a deadly vanguard captain of the Federation.

commanders.Name: Sandora
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to deal 30% Scattering damage to all stacks in the enemy fleet. Affected by the Accuracy and Initiative attributes.
commanders.Description: Sandora grew up on the Saturn Observatory. She enjoys knitting, drawing, and baking. Her ideal partner is someone who doesn't smoke, enjoys long walks on the beach, and helps with the housework at least twice a week. She works as a Captain in the Federation Militia and she's known across the galaxy as "The Supernova", a nickname she dislikes. If you're looking for a girl who can cook you a delicious meal, knit you a Christmas sweater, and hit your enemies like a galatic battering ram, swipe right!

commanders.Name: Mcgonagall
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to reduce an enemy's attack power by 50% the next round Affected by the Focus attribute.
commanders.Description: Mcgonagall is the commanding officer in the Federation Academy. The teacher of thousands of cadets, Mcgonagall emphasizes the fundamentals of combat and leadership. No unnecessary risks, no daring escapades. Just slow, steady progress. Strict and fair, she is the ideal teacher. Many famous captains remember her lessons and pay her visits from time to time.

commanders.Name: Maxius
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to increase the Accuracy of all friendly forces within 4 spaces by 5. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Maxius was born to privilege but he did not take on the life of a socialite as many of his elite peers did. Instead he pursued a career in the military and quickly rose through the ranks, both in part to his family reputation and his own abilities. Mature and congenial, Maxius is respected in the Federation military as an excellent instructor of marksmanship.

commanders.Name: Panvi
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to deal triple damage when attacking, but also inflicts 10% damage to self. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Headstrong Panvi loves exploring the unknown parts of the universe and burying her head in research. Needless to say, she has encountered various obstacles and enemies during her adventures. And whenever she starts a battle, her only thought is to end it as quickly as possible. She does not hesitate to put her life on the line.

commanders.Name: Motima
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to trigger the max Hit Rate of all active weapons when attacking the enemy. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: 'Doomshoot' Motima was a captain of the militia in a lawless fringe colony called Weirest. She didn't last long there, despite being an excellent law enforcer. She was brought back to life using a mix of cybernetic enhancements and bizzare potions by a man who calls himself 'Whateley'. Motima left Weirest to become a fleet Captain and found herself able to interface with her ship computers, even channeling her thoughts from her ship to the rest of her fleet, which can fire on targets with deadly accuracy.

commanders.Name: Luville
commanders.Comment: Attacks have a chance to inflict an additional 30% damage to the enemy fleet at the beginning of the next round. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: She was once the champion of the Women's Tactical Tournament at the Academy. Her reputation spread and she became known as the 'Flaming Fist.' Luville is a woman of many accomplishments: Fleet 7 veteran, sports commentator, motivational speaker, actor, bestselling author... But of course, becoming an excellent captain is her greatest achievement of all. Never one to shy away from challenges, she is about to plunge herself into the war to prove her worth.

commanders.Name: Ann Nada
commanders.Comment: Attacks have a chance to deal an additional 40% Piercing damage. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: The older half of the Galactic Federation's most famous pair of twins, the Nada sisters are weapon experts who specialize in maximizing the kill zone of any weapon. Ann is often thought of as the 'brainy one' among the sisters. A member of the Interstellar Academy of Sciences, she juggles her time between leading the line in the fight against the Corsairs, her scientific pursuits, and getting her sister Lee out of trouble.

commanders.Name: Lee Nada
commanders.Comment: Attacks have a chance to deal an extra 50% Scattering damage to target row. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: The younger half of the Galactic Federation's most famous pair of twins, the Nada sisters are weapon experts who specialize in maximizing the kill zone of any weapon. Lee is the more vivacious and reckless of the twins. Well-liked and popular, Lee revels in testing her sister's patience and her ability to get Lee out of trouble.

commanders.Name: Heloyce
commanders.Comment: Removes the formation penalty when a fleet is under attack and increases fleet Stability. Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Heloyce is the Federation's best tactician. She practically wrote the manual on fleet formations. She's seen every formation there is, and probably knows a few more that no one has thought of yet. Whether it's leading a squadron of frigates in a stratospheric dogfight against Corsairs or launching an armada of battleships in a siege against the Xanthas, Heloyce's command and control is a sight to behold.

commanders.Name: Shabasti
commanders.Comment: Increases the Evasion of friendly Captains within 4 Squares by 5 (stackable). Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Shabasti isn't just any military brat, her father is the legendary General Eugahn. Shabasti followed the General everywhere in her formative years. Her strong sense of duty compelled her to enlist in the Federation. Though only 15, Shabasti got in thanks to her father who saw a maturity in her far beyond her years. A close friend of Rayph, Shabasti is a master of defensive arts. She has an entourage of scientists and engineers developing technology on-the-fly to support diversion and stealth.

commanders.Name: Nora
commanders.Comment: Once per round, has a chance to destroy enemy troops when they attack. Affected by the Accuracy and Evasion attributes.
commanders.Description: Among of the youngest captains in the Federation, Nora has been on the fast track her whole life. A prodigy of the Academy, she graduated with full honors at a younger age than most people are allowed to enroll. After that, she shot to the rank of captain in record time. Known for her strict, no-nonsense demeanor, Nora often employs the most direct solution to a conflict, ruthlessly dispatching her enemies and taking no prisoners.

commanders.Name: Mantie
commanders.Comment: Increases the chances of killing the enemy commander at the cost of a 3% increase to the attacker's own fatality rate. Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Mantie's childhood dream of flying among the stars was fulfilled when she signed up for the galactic military. She seems brash and reckless, but overcomes her weaknesses by tenaciously targeting an opposing commander, even if she must risk her own life. Ability: increases the chances of killing the enemy commander at the cost of a 3% increase to the attacker's own fatality rate.

commanders.Name: Vinna Fleu
commanders.Comment: Requires 30% less EXP to level-up. Attacks have a chance to increase one of Vinna Fleu's attributes at random by 10 until the end combat. Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Vinna 'Brainiac' Fleu could've gone into any profession and been successful. Wherever she goes sets trends and paves new paths. Everyone who has attended school with this prodigy predicts a bright future for this pixie-faced lady. No one in their wildest dreams expected this scholar to join the military as a fleet captain. "It's the most exciting thing in the galaxy," is her rationale for this career move. To Vinna, there's no better reward than the thrill of the chase.

commanders.Name: Singhri
commanders.Comment: Copies an enemy Captain's skills when attacking or defending. Skill effects copied will not be retained after the exchange of fire.
commanders.Description: Singhri is one of the most powerful captains in the Federation. She only answers to the President and is constantly away on top secret missions. She only returns to Federation space during the holidays when she takes a rare few days on leave.

commanders.Name: Devi Sounten
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to reduce damage taken by 15% and enables all ships to share damage. Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: Devi grew up in a Federation orphanage on Mars. It was a difficult childhood spent scrapping with older, bigger children and witnessing the effects of hunger and poverty. Her time there kindled a desire to join the Federation. It ultimately moulded her into a tough, independent captain who always looks out for the welfare of her subordinates.

commanders.Name: Rayo
commanders.Comment: If Rayo is attacking or attacked and the sum of his 4 base attributes is higher than the enemy Captain's, the latter will not be able to use skills.
commanders.Description: More of a scholar than a commander, Rayo started out as a researcher for the Federation's Bureau of Intelligence. He had a gift for ferreting out secrets and analyzing complicated data. Combined with his nosy nature, this gift helped him create indepth files on both his allies and enemies. His snooping was eventually discovered and he was expelled from the Bureau. However, his natural abilities and store of knowledge made him too valuable (and dangerous) to lose, and he was promoted to Captain.

commanders.Name: Luxor
commanders.Comment: Attacking or defending has a chance to increase the enemy's Fuel costs by 400%. Affected by the Focus attribute.
commanders.Description: Luxor isn't the most powerful captain in the Federation nor the most respected. And his accomplishments on the battlefield are unremarkable. He is, however, the richest man in the entire Federation and that makes him everyone's best friend. With connections in all four corners of the galaxy, Luxor controls the market for anything and everything. He is a captain only because it suits his purposes, but when the time comes he can make his enemies pay in more ways than one.

commanders.Name: Yardarm
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to ignore the target's Shield, Shield Modules, and Stability during attack. Affected by the Accuracy and Initiative attributes.
commanders.Description: Yardarm was born in Earth Colony 346, one of the few archivist colonies established by the Federation. Unfortunately, the colony was on the fringes of uncharted space and one of the first to be hit when the Glaus invaded. The colonists were completely unprepared for battle and young Yardarm witnessed first-hand the horrors of war. The young orphan became extremely withdrawn and reticent. But when it's time to fight, his inner rage explodes out in a tremendous frenzy.

commanders.Name: Knarr Toa
commanders.Comment: During movement, has a chance to increase damage dealt by 15% and prevent enemy fleets from targeting Knarr's fleet for an attack until the end of the Round. This skill will not trigger if Knarr's fleet is the only fleet left on the side. Affected by Focus and Initiative attributes.
commanders.Description: Known as "The One That Talks" in the Maulv Empire, Knarr Toa is one of the few Maulv to join the Federation. A deeply millitaristic race, the Maulv are usually famed for their strength, agility, and ruthlessness in battle. Although he is a capable warrior, Knarr is known more for his diplomatic skills than his combat skills. Fluent in over 300 languages, he instinctively understands the habits and predispositions of cultures all over the galaxy and finds solutions to the most convoluted problems.

commanders.Name: Rolance
commanders.Comment: Increases Ballistic Weapons damage. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Rolance doesn't fancy himself as a fleet captain, preferring to dabble in ballistics, munitions, and his math equations. Most of the artillery employed by the Federation was actually designed by him. As a weapons specialist, Rolance had the 'privilege' of accompanying Federation warships on expeditions. He eventually signed on as a fleet captain after stating that he gets to enjoy "far greater prestige and benefits" than his previous role as a weapons designer.

commanders.Name: Siv-Ell
commanders.Comment: Increases Energy Weapons damage. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Siv-Ell is an orphaned Xen who was adopted, raised, and trained by the Federation into a formidable captain. With his menacing looks, Siv-Ell strikes terror into the hearts of his enemies. However, Siv-Ell is actually a very tender soul. He spends whatever time he has away from the battlefield with the children in his orphanage. Siv-Ell fights for the future of his surrogate family.

commanders.Name: Tyren
commanders.Comment: Increases Missile Weapons damage. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Few have seen Tyren without his exo-suit and lived to tell about it. In fact, no one knows why he's so averse to being outside of its confines. Some speculate that he suffers from some kind of agoraphobia. Others guess that the suit functions as a form of life-support. There's even speculation that Tyren is a sort of mechanical doll. Given Tyren's tendency to work with explosives and nuclear warheads, maybe he just wants to be well-covered.

commanders.Name: Essido
commanders.Comment: Increases Shuttle Weapons damage. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: Before the tragedy that befell Essido, he was the Federation's foremost Human pilot. Flamboyant, likeable, and incredibly skilled, Essido lost it all in an explosion mid-flight, suspected to be sabotage. He was literally put back together as a cyborg, as the Federation's cold-blooded killing machine. Essido's flies crewless fleets, despising all organic lifeforms. Instead he operates the fleet like a hive mind, particularly adept at controlling shuttles.

commanders.Name: Ike Leon
commanders.Comment: If the sum of Ike Leon's 4 base attributes exceeds that of the enemy Captain's, Chain Attacks will trigger a Critical Strike for the next attacking stack. Likewise, a Critical Strike will trigger Chain Attacks for the next attacking stack.
commanders.Description: At the end of the Vong War, Federation scientists attempted to use their unique bio-synthetic technology to create a team of supersoldiers. After many high profile incidents, the project was shut down. One of only three successful experiments, Ike Leon is a closely-guarded Federation secret. With his synthetic implants and augmented biology, Ike is a master of the battlefield. Able to efficiently plan, command, and fight, Ike is every bit the perfect soldier he was made to be.

commanders.Name: Dilara
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to fully restore Shields and Hull. Affected by the Initiative attribute.
commanders.Description: Dilara was born and raised on Outpost 353, a small space station of no major importance. Together with her parents, she repaired and maintained passing ships. When she came of age, Dilara enlisted into the Militia. Through sheer will and dedication she rose to the rank of Captain. Fastidious to the extreme, she runs a very tight ship. Her crew is famous for being among the most disciplined and efficient in the Federation. Nobody does ship repairs in the heat of battle quite like Dilara and her engineers.

commanders.Name: Hellena Amarant
commanders.Comment: When attacking, there is a chance to instantly finish reloading weapons. Affected by the Accuracy and Focus attributes.
commanders.Description: Born to a prominent Earth family, Hellena Amarant was destined for a political marriage once she came of age. Unwilling to follow the path laid out by her strict parents, she ran away with a group of pirates when she was 16. Even after joining the Federation, Hellena the Demon kept her reputation as a wild and unpredictable rebel. Her ship is full of the modifications and jerry-rigging she learned from her time with the pirates, and she's famous for smash and grab tactics in battle.

commanders.Name: Draxido
commanders.Comment: While attacking, has a chance of triggering a Chain Attack. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: The son of the ex-President of the Federation, Draxido was on the fast track for success. That is, until his father was found guilty of corruption. Draxido was instantly blacklisted, serving as a turret washer for three years before he unintentionally saved the Maulv ambassador from a space slug. He was promoted to Admiral, only to be instantly demoted when he arrived late to his own ceremony. Though he is an able captain, one thing is for sure: When Draxido is around, you never know what might happen.

commanders.Name: Rafia
commanders.Comment: If the the total combined value of Rafia's 4 base attributes exceed those of the opposing commander, the stability of her ships will be increased to their maximum strength.
commanders.Description: Ask around Federation headquarters and you'll find two very different names for Rafia: "Rafia the Bulwark" and "Rafia the Coward." Known for her penchant to play it safe, Rafia makes it a point to minimize casualties in a battle. This has polarised opinions among the top brass, but men are always happy to be under her command, and she's highly respected by her subordinates.

commanders.Name: Orzie Gorsbon
commanders.Comment: If Orzie Gorsbon's Focus is higher than the Focus of the enemy Captain, he will reflect 20% of damage from enemy attacks back to its source.
commanders.Description: Orzie is an amiable man, pleasant to have lunch with and a great drinking buddy. As a captain, he relates well to his subordinates and knows his way among Federation headquarters. All in all, he is a fine captain. Unfortunately, he is also a complete madman on the battlefield. But what he lacks in talent he more than makes up for in confidence. He would rather die than retreat, even against superior opposition. His crew can often be seen praying or drinking.

commanders.Name: Gellert
commanders.Comment: Deals additional damage to Hull. Additional damage is based on the amount of damage dealt to Shields. Affected by Accuracy and Initiative.
commanders.Description: Gellert "The Admiral" Cavendish is a legendary figure within the Federation. Despite his many victories and accomplishments, he has never risen beyond the rank of Captain. Some speculate that this is by choice, while others say it is because of his brash attitude and impulsive behaviour. Nevertheless, Gellert still cuts an imposing figure on the bridge, and his reputation ensures that no one ever takes him lightly.

commanders.Name: Zarc
commanders.Comment: When attacking, if Zarc's Accuracy is higher than an enemy Captain's Evasion, the enemy fleet's Integrated Defense and Agility attributes will be ignored.
commanders.Description: Born with the innate ability to identify weak points, Zarc is a natural commander on the battlefield. He's able to instantly identify and exploit any weaknesses the enemy has. Fortunately, or unfortunately, Zarc is also born with rugged good looks and a charming personality, and no one knows this better than Zarc himself. His crew is stocked with the prettiest academy graduates, and it is common knowledge that Zarc could have had a much better career if he wasn't so distracted.

commanders.Name: Don Rosinante
commanders.Comment: Each time Don Rosinante's ships destroy all ships in a single fleet stack, his ships will double their attack power. (Can be stacked up to 8 times.)
commanders.Description: Don Rosinante is one of the Seven Enforcers, an organization of seven pirates turned privateers in service of the Federation. While he operated as a pirate, Don ran rampant in the Omega Cluster, hitting merchants, travellers, and even Federation supply vessels. After many failed attempts to subdue his rogue fleet, the Federation offered to make him an Enforcer. Now, he leads attacks on Federation targets, taking wild joy in the destruction of his enemies.

commanders.Name: Andrul
commanders.Comment: If Andrul's Evasion is higher than the enemy Captain's Accuracy, Andrul's ships will not suffer any scattering damage.
commanders.Description: Andrul is a true grit and grime officer. After enlisting at the age of 16, he started as a cook in the militia peeling potatoes and washing latrines. With his positive attitude and glowing reviews, Andrul climbed up the ranks. He now holds a position of command, but remembers his days on the lower decks and relates well with his crew. He has a natural charisma and has always regarded as "one of the guys." He's cultivated a very tight knit crew, all of whom are willing to die for one another.

commanders.Name: Rin Giger
commanders.Comment: Rin Giger's ships deal 10% more damage each round for every square her fleet moves.
commanders.Description: Born in the deserts of Calypso 5, Rin Giger learned the perils of indiscipline and waste from a young age. Known as "The Spartan," Rin keeps her ship free of any frills. No recreation decks, no junk food, and everyone must be in bed by 10 pm sharp. Her crew is exempt from inspections and other regimental nonsense but they're expected to conserve energy instead of monkeying about. In battle, Rin only changes position when a more strategic spot opens up, taking pride in strategic and efficient victories.

commanders.Name: Cthulhu
commanders.Comment: Cthulhu's fleet deal an extra 300% damage to all Masterwork Armored targets.
commanders.Description: Cthulhu hails from Ryleh, an ocean planet in the Cassiopeiae system. It is the only place known to produce elgon, the panacean algae. Ryleh is constantly raided by pirates and other hostile planets. Just when the situation became dire, the Federation offered to take the planet under its protection, and the desperate Ryleans agreed. Cthulhu, their greatest warrior, was ostensibly sent to fight for the Federation as a gesture of appreciation. However, some whisper that he was sent to keep an eye on them.

commanders.Name: Stella
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to ignore the enemy's defensive modules and deal triple damage when attacking, but also inflicts 10% recoil damage to the ship commanded.Affected by the Accuracy stat.
commanders.Description: The tale of Sleeping Beauty gets a dark twist in the story of Stella. Once upon a time she was the beloved princess of Skane... until she was kidnapped by an obsessed stalker and frozen in a cryogenic sleep. Hundreds of brave souls attempted to wake the princess without luck until Serge Aldir came along. Able to contact her mind, Serge taught her his arcane ways. Now free from her cryogenic slumber, Stella roams the galaxy with her paramour as a fearsome Mystic for hire.

commanders.Name: 主宰之劍
commanders.Comment: This skill has a chance to deal an additional 30% Scattering damage to all enemy forces and reflect all absorbed damage to its source.(Affected by all 4 stats.)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: Kageion
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to avoid damage. If attacked, the enemy will receive 10% more damage the next round (stackable).(Affected by the Evasion and Focus stats.)
commanders.Description: Kageion is one of the Wrotn, a strange nomadic race that hunts all over the galaxy. When they come of age, Wrotns must prove themselves by surviving a life-threatening challenge. They can't return to their tribe until they bring honor to their name. This makes the adult Wrotn fierce and indomitable. Their fighting prowess is prized amongst military recruiters. For his coming-of-age challenge, Kageion fought for the Federation and declared that he won't return to his tribe until he's made Admiral. Looking at his accomplishments so far, Kageion may not have to wait long.

commanders.Name: Crion Svetana
commanders.Comment: Chance to cause the enemy fleet to skip their next Round and reduce the enemy Captain's primary attributes to 0 for the next Round when Crion Svetana attacks. Affected by the Accuracy and Initiative attributes.
commanders.Description: Just the mention of Crion Svetana's name is enough to make galactic citizens pray to their makers. Famous for his underhand tactics, Crion has been known to lie, cheat, steal, blackmail, kidnap, and assassinate, stopping at nothing to achieve victory. And that's just for scouting missions. Many an opposing captain has inexplicably retreated, surrendered, or been found dead just before a confrontation with Crion, earning him the nickname "Screwdriver".

commanders.Name: Kasey Kei
commanders.Comment: This skill has a chance to deal an additional 50% Scattering Damage and 40% Piercing damage during all attacks.(Affected by the Accuracy stats.)
commanders.Description: Kasey Kei is not much of a party girl. All work and no play, her efficient personality carries over to her personal life. Known as the Federation's "Problem Solver." Kasey takes care of any problems they encounter in the most straightforward way. Obstacles are just an annoyance to Kasey and she'll bat aside anything that stands between her and her goal.

commanders.Name: 開路先鋒
commanders.Comment: This skill has a chance to your fleets an additional 3 spaces and increase attack values by 10% for every space that fleet moves.(Affected by the Initiative stat.)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: T-00
commanders.Comment: Has increased Critical Strike and Chain Attack rates. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.
commanders.Description: T-00 is the first of six known androids designed by the legendary Dr. Yuteng Hoong. With the first fully-functional positronic brain, T-00 was given superior strength, speed, and intelligence. Unfortunately, T-00's emotional programming was lacking. It wasn't long before the android began showing signs of emotional instability and aggression. Deemed a danger to humans, T-00 was sent to patrol the outer fringes of space, where it rips apart any space pirate it finds.

commanders.Name: Adelvaiss
commanders.Comment: Increases the Shield and Structure values of friendly fleets within 4 spaces by 8% after each Round and has a chance to reduce the maximum Structure and Shield values of enemy fleets within 2 spaces by 5% after every Round. Affected by the Initiative attribute.(Affected by the Initiative stat.)
commanders.Description: Upon the rocky outback of a moon near Ursa Minor, a primitive people reside in peace away from the wars that ravage the galaxy. They worship the elemental forces of electricity. Discovered recently by the Federation as a race with immense psionic potential, Adelvaiss was brought back to the core planets along with her kin for "cultural exchange." Next-in-line as oracle, Adelvaiss now serves as a fleet captain.

commanders.Name: 光明之刃
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to deal double damage and 30% Scattering damage to all ships in an enemy fleet.(Affected by Accuracy and Initiative stats)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 致命屠刀
commanders.Comment: Chance to deal 2x damage to the enemy. Total damage is unaffected by target's Shield, Modules, and Stability.(Affected by Accuracy and Initiative stats.)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: Golga Tzos
commanders.Comment: Increases Stability, ignores formation penalties, and negates Scattering damage from enemy attacks if Golga Tzo's Evasion is higher than the enemy's Accuracy.
commanders.Description: Golga Tzos was once an outlaw kingpin at odds with the Galactic Federation until the Corsairs seized his resources and territory. While Golga's elite crew of traffickers and smugglers were indomitable, his weaker gangs didn't fare as well. As the saying goes, the enemy of my enemy is my friend. In his desperation, Golga sought help from the Federation. He and his cronies now operate on the other side of the law. Revenge on the Corsairs is at the top of his agenda.

commanders.Name: 無息戰歌
commanders.Comment: If the sum of Death From Above's 4 base stats exceeds that of the enemy commander's, double attacks will trigger a critical strike for all ships in the following fleet slot. Likewise, a critical strike will trigger double attacks. Enemy commander abilities are nullified when Death From Above attacks or is attacked.(Affected by all 4 stats)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 潛伏者
commanders.Comment: During movement, has a chance to increase damage dealt by 15%; and prevent enemy fleets from targeting Leech Lurkers' fleet for an attack until the end of the Round. (This ability will not trigger if Leech Lurkers' fleet is the only fleet left on the side.) After movement, has a chance to reduce maximum Shields and Structures of all enemy fleets within 2 Squares by 5%.(Affected by Accuracy and Initiative attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: Polly Dioscuri
commanders.Comment: When attacking, there is a chance to instantly reload all weapons and prevent the enemy Commander's ability for the next round.(Affected by Accuracy and Focus stats)
commanders.Description: The Dioscuri twins were born as a result of a now-defunct clandestine Federation program to bio-engineer super soldiers using spliced DNA of humans and various other alien races. Most of the subjects proved unstable, but the fratenal twins were an unprecedented success. After getting abducted and raised by the separatists who exposed the program, Polly was rescued by Castor who had escaped to the Federation earlier. Polly now uses her time-altering psionic ability as a fleet captain for the Federation.

commanders.Name: 毀滅之刃
commanders.Comment: Chance to deal 6x damage while attacking, but inflicts 10% of total damage to your ships.(Affected by the Accuracy and Initiative attribute.)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 鋼鐵意志
commanders.Comment: If the sum of Iron Maidens' 4 base stats exceeds those of the enemy commander's, their ships' stability will increase to their maximum. Also, Iron Maidens have a chance to fully restore Shields and Structures each round.(Affected by Initiative and Evasion attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 殘暴之力
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to ignore the enemy's defensive modules and deal additional structural damage. Actual damage is based on amount dealt to enemy shields.
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 送葬者
commanders.Comment: Chance to deal 3x damage and instantly reload weapons, but also reflects 10% damage to attacking ship.(Affected by Accuracy and Focus attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 末日之影
commanders.Comment: Chance to deal 30% Scattering damage to enemy ships and instantly reload weapons.(Affected by Accuracy and Focus attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 能量屏障
commanders.Comment: Chance to avoid damage and increase enemy He3 costs by up to 5 times.(Affected by Evasion and Focus attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 墮落天使
commanders.Comment: While attacking or defending, has a chance to increase enemy He3 cost by up to 5 times and reduce enemy attack power by 50% for the next round.(Affected by the Focus attribute)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 嗜血戰魂
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 雷神之怒
commanders.Comment: Has a chance to be unaffected by the target's Shield, Shield Modules and Stability during an attack and instantly reload all weapons after the attack.(Affected by Accuracy and Initiative attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 復仇荊棘
commanders.Comment: Carbuncle Cohort reflects 20% of damage taken, reduces damage taken by 15%, and finally spreads all remaining damage equally across all ships in the fleet.(Affected by the Evasion attribute.)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 神聖戰歌
commanders.Comment: Has a chance each round to fully restore all Shield and Structure points and increase the Evasion attribute of all friendly forces within 4 spaces by 5. This buff can be stacked.(Affected by the Initiative attribute)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 戰爭之災
commanders.Comment: If all ships in a single enemy fleet slot are destroyed by ships in a single fleet slot under the command of The Ravagers, Attack Power of those ships will double. This buff can be stacked up to 8 times. Also has a chance to instantly reload all weapons for those ships. (Affected by the Accuracy and Focus attributes.)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 首領之傲
commanders.Comment: If the sum of Rex Scuta's Base Stats exceed those of the enemy commander, the Stability of Rex Scuta's ships will increase to the maximum. Effect also nullifies the enemy commander's abilities.
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 暗影守護者
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: Titan
commanders.Comment: Each time Titan levels up, the total increment of Titan's four attributes is increased by an additional 5 points.
commanders.Description: Titan was the first among the god-like Illiada to appear in this galaxy. Not only did he ace all aptitude and physical tests in the Federation Academy, he redesigned them shortly after he graduated. The Titan Tests are now the ultimate assessment of skill for the best cadets. Even among Iliada, Titan is a paragon of excellence. His ability to unleash the full potential of any intelligent lifeform has made him the most sought-after partner and teacher in the Federation.

commanders.Name: 諸神黃昏
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 蓋亞審判
commanders.Comment: Each time Hand of Lelantos level up, the total value of their 4 attributes will increase by an additional 5 points. If the Hand of Lelantos' Accuracy is higher than the enemy commander's Dodge, any attacks will ignore the enemy fleet's Overall Ship Defense and Agility.(Affected by Accuracy attribute)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 星辰破碎
commanders.Comment: Each time the Hekatian Witnesses level up, the total increment of Hekatian Witnesses' four attributes is increased by an additional 5 points. Hekatian Witnesses have a chance to destroy an entire ship stack each time it is dealt damage by the Hekatian Witnesses.(Affected by Accuracy and Evasion attributes)
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 虛空恐懼
commanders.Comment: Each time Dopplegangers level up, the total increment of the Dopplegangers' 4 attributes is increased by an additional 5 points. At the beginning of each engagement, the Dopplegangers will copy the enemy commander's skill until the end of the engagement. The conditions required for the copied skill to trigger is also copied. The chance of the copied skill to trigger is now affected by the Dopplegangers' attributes.
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: 死亡蓮華
commanders.Comment: Each time Erebus Errants levels up, the total value of their 4 attributes will increase by an additional 5 points. Erebus Errants also has a chance to negate all damage when attacked.Affected by the Evasion attribute.
commanders.Description: 無

commanders.Name: Cassius
commanders.Comment: When attacking, Cassius has a chance to move the enemy fleet back 3 spaces. Can only be used once per turn.Affected by the Accuracy and Evasion attributes.
commanders.Description: Cassius is feared as much as he is respected. Unrivaled in hand-to-hand combat, his fleet maneuvers are as visceral as his brawls. A troubled and rebellious youth, he eventually turned his life around by directing his anger into the fight against space pirates. One of his most famous exploits was a daring raid into a space pirate colony. His squad of 10 rangers took down the defenders and apprehended the pirate captain without a single casualty, making Cassius a legend throughout the galaxy.

commanders.Name: Bain
commanders.Comment: When Bain is attacked, there is a chance to reduce the enemy commander's 4 attributes to 0 for the next Round.(Affected by Accuracy and Evasion attributes)
commanders.Description: Once Professor Bain, the director of the Institute of Research on Intelligent Life, Bain is hailed as the greatest genius of our generation. Sadly, his scholarly pursuits were brought to an end by a freak accident. While conducting an experiment on muscle memory, a glitch in the power systems caused a chain reaction, displacing parts of Bain's memory with that of his subject, Captain Jaa-si Leen. Bain became a fierce fighter and leader in battle at the cost of his prior brilliance.

commanders.Name: Krina Klaus
commanders.Comment: When Krina Klaus is attacked, there is a chance to reduce the enemy commander's 4 attributes to 0 for the next Round.(Affected by Accuracy and Evasion attributes)
commanders.Description: Krina Klaus hails from Skane-XXV, a star system located at the edge of the galaxy. Barren and impoverished compared to other worlds, it is nonetheless a place of mirth and peace. All that came to an end when marauding pirates brought fire and war to Skane-XXV. As her home planet laid in ruin, Princess Krina was sent to the Federation for her safety. Receiving tutelage from Shabasti, Krina Klaus now dedicates herself to protecting the innocent and weak from those who use violence to achieve their ends.

items.name: Angla
items.comment: Reduces hospital time and prevents anyone from killing the Commander. Affected by the Evasion attribute.

items.name: Rio
items.comment: Has a chance to reduce the maximum Structure and Shield values of enemy fleets within 2 spaces by 5% after every turn. Affected by the Focus attribute.

items.name: Natiya Veda
items.comment: At the start of each round, has a chance to increase the Captain's Initiative by its level x10. Affected by the Initiative attribute.

items.name: Reginald
items.comment: Has a chance to reduce the enemy Captain's attack power and seal the use of his or her skill for the next round. Affected by the Focus attribute.

items.name: Evey Snabar
items.comment: Has a chance to ignore enemy defensive modules while attacking. Affected by the Accuracy attribute.

items.name: Stani Baradeon
items.comment: Has a chance to prevent the enemy from moving and attacking for the next round. Affected by the Accuracy and Focus attributes.

items.name: Sephina
items.comment: Has a chance to move an extra 3 squares. Affected by the Initiative attribute.

items.name: Jace
items.comment: Has a chance to prevent modules from consuming He3 while attacking or defending. Affected by the Focus attribute.

items.name: Maletiz
items.comment: Has a chance to absorb all damage and reflect it back to the attacker. Affected by the Evasion and Focus attributes.

items.name: Niet-Khuul
items.comment: Has a chance to reduce damage from attacks to 0. Affected by the Evasion attribute.

items.name: Jero
items.comment: When attacked, has a chance to inflict a condition on the enemy fleet, causing it to take 10% more damage in the next round (stackable). Affected by the Accuracy attribute.

items.name: Jaa-si Leen
items.comment: Has a chance when attacking to reduce the enemy Captain's 4 attributes to 0 for the next Round. Affected by Initiative and Focus attributes.

items.name: Alicia Pike
